dossier.scp_unleashed.352.title: Baba Yaga
dossier.scp_unleashed.352.caption: SCP-352 at the edge of a wood, photographed shortly before contact was lost.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-352 is to be held in a covered pen of reinforced timber no smaller than ten metres to a side, with a roof at least four metres high. %rPen specifications withheld.%r
Personnel are to observe SCP-352 by camera only. No one is to stand where she can see them clearly.
**Under no circumstances is a sleeping SCP-352 to be disturbed.**

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-352 appears to be a very old woman, a little over one and a half metres tall and badly stooped. She wears a long, dark, layered dress that reaches the ground, a heavy shawl and a red headscarf, and she walks with a gnarled wooden cane. Her face is deeply lined and her nose is long and crooked. She mutters to herself almost constantly.
SCP-352 moves slowly and appears frail. She drifts toward people she can sense, even through walls, but makes no move against them from a distance.

When someone comes close, the hem of her dress lifts and two enormous legs unfold beneath it. They are scaled, yellow and taloned, like the legs of a bird. On them SCP-352 stands more than three metres tall, and she can outrun a sprinting man. %rCasualty figures withheld.%r

page.title: Addendum 352-1: The Long Sleep
text: Once SCP-352 has killed, she does not hunt again at once. She settles on the ground near where the hunt ended, folds her legs beneath her like a roosting hen and sleeps. The sleep has lasted for days. She has never been seen to eat.
She always wakes on her own, and she always starts walking again.

page.title: Addendum 352-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-352 has no recovery site. Her file surfaced in the Archive, and soon afterwards she was seen walking at the edge of a wood not far from its reader. Other readers have reported other sightings. %rIt is not known whether they saw the same woman.%r

archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp352.0: An old woman with a cane has been seen walking at the edge of the trees.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp352.1: Keep your distance. Do not let her see you up close.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp352.no_room: There is no room for SCP-352 there.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp352.not_restin: There is no sleeping SCP-352 nearby.
SCP-352, Baba Yaga: a small, bent old woman in a long dark dress, a shawl and a red headscarf, leaning on a crooked cane. Keter-class.
She wanders slowly and seems frail from a distance. Those who come too close learn what the dress hides. After a hunt she sleeps for a long while.
She never spawns naturally. Her file comes from the Archive. Operators can use /scp_unleashed scp352 with spawn, hunt, rest, wake or status.
